description: This file defines Swagger annotations and data structures for the Loan Products API in the Apache Fineract project. It includes classes representing request and response schemas, enums, and internal data models for documenting the API endpoints related to loan product management.

classes.name: LoanProductsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes that define the schema for API requests, responses, and related data models for loan products.

classes.name: LoanProductChargeData
classes.description: Schema for representing a loan product charge, including its ID and amount.

classes.name: LoanProductChargeToGLAccountMapper
classes.description: Maps a charge to its associated GL account for income.

classes.name: PostLoanProductsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new loan product, including all relevant parameters such as name, currency, terms, settings, accounts, and various options.

classes.name: PostLoanProductsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response when a new loan product is created, primarily returning the resource ID.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsDaysInMonthType
classes.description: Schema for enumerating days-in-month conventions used in loan calculations.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsDaysInYearType
classes.description: Schema for enumerating days-in-year conventions used in loan calculations.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the detailed response for a loan product, including all properties, nested types, options, and related data relevant for API consumers.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the template data to create or edit a loan product, including options for currencies, interest types, accounts, and configurations.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the detailed response of a specific loan product identified by its ID, including settings, mappings, options, and nested configurations.

classes.name: PutLoanProductsProductIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a specific loan product by its ID with new parameters, similar to the creation schema.

classes.name: PutLoanProductsProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a loan product by ID, including resource ID and changes.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsChargeOffReasonOptions
classes.description: Schema for options of charge-off reasons applicable to loan products.

classes.name: GetLoanProductsWriteOffReasonOptions
classes.description: Schema for options of write-off reasons applicable to loan products.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentData
classes.description: Schema representing advanced payment configurations for loan products, including future installment rules.

classes.name: PaymentAllocationOrder
classes.description: Defines the order of payment allocation rules.

classes.name: CreditAllocationData
classes.description: Schema for credit allocation rules associated with loan products.

classes.name: CreditAllocationOrder
classes.description: Defines the order of credit allocation rules.
